title.en: Vanilla RNN and backpropagation through time
title.zh: 标准 RNN 与随时间反向传播

en.a: Track how a recurrent hidden-state Jacobian carries or loses information across time.
en.b: Derive BPTT, weight-sharing gradients, truncation bias, and clipping from one unrolled computation graph.

zh.a: 追踪循环隐藏状态雅可比矩阵如何在时间维度上传递或丢失信息。
zh.b: 从一个展开的计算图推导 BPTT、权重共享梯度、截断偏差和梯度裁剪。
